direction.premise: A small photographic print workshop with a paper proof that represents real physical dimensions.
direction.composition: A compact photo contact list and dimension controls face a separate A4 proof, stacked vertically on narrow screens.
direction.shapeLanguage: Rectangular photo thumbnails and paper rectangles use true proportions, thin rules and restrained square controls.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Uncoated white paper over a matte sage workbench distinguishes the printable surface from editing chrome.
direction.paletteLogic: Neutral green-tinted surround separates the white proof, with dark ink for controls and green for the upload and export actions.
direction.typography: System sans serif, small uppercase instrument labels and tabular dimensions establish a compact technical hierarchy.
direction.signature: Changing a centimetre dimension immediately recomposes the physical paper layout and page count.
direction.distinction: The real white sheet and per-photo measurements replace decorative game displays, maps and abstract dashboards.

architecture.primaryVerb: Assign dimensions to imported photographs and proof the exact layout of a physical A4 sheet before exporting.
architecture.physicalFeedback: Buttons depress slightly and the paper recomposes immediately when a numerical dimension or copy count is committed.
architecture.spatialRationale: Keep dimensions outside the physical proof so the preview remains readable; stack the editing list and paper on phones.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Two rectangular photo-editing and proofing surfaces replace the circular sonar instrument and physical navigation pad.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Users enter physical dimensions and export a static document rather than spending resources to explore a hidden grid.

comparisons.spatialDifference: An ordered strip of photograph settings sits alongside discrete white paper rectangles, not a continuous interactive geography.
comparisons.interactionDifference: The sheet is recalculated from explicit dimensions, not through pausing and branching a simulated autonomous history.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A typesetting proof of proportional A4 sheets replaces an immersive map bounded by a timeline and historical event panel.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Editing dimensions and print settings produces downloadable pages rather than navigating among historical events.

comparisons.spatialDifference: The workspace is composed of white portrait or landscape sheets instead of a colored matrix of coastal cells.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Users submit actual photographs and set exact centimetres rather than changing the ownership or color of cells.

comparisons.spatialDifference: The core spatial area is a measured rectangular paper proof beside thumbnail controls rather than a connected square puzzle grid.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Physical size inputs and repeat counts alter a print arrangement instead of turning electrical connections.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Separate white sheets and a photo list replace a continuous train timetable and horizontal planning timeline.
comparisons.interactionDifference: The editing loop produces a physical print file rather than allocating departure times on a railway network.

production.renderer: DOM and CSS percentage positions provide a responsive sheet proof while Canvas renders the same geometry at 300 dpi for PDF.
production.focalAsset: Actual user photographs and procedural paper rectangles form the focal image; the icon is a hand-authored contact sheet SVG.

motion.character: Precise immediate recomposition with restrained short opacity and press responses suited to a measuring tool.
motion.action: Changing the sheet orientation or photo size changes the measured rectangles and number of resulting pages.
motion.anticipation: The current numerical value and labeled control make the next edit explicit without decorative animation.
motion.response: The paper aspect and photograph rectangles update in the same input change handler without an animation queue.
motion.followThrough: The page count and physical dimensions remain visible after the new layout appears on the workbench.
motion.interruption: Each committed setting replaces the previous proof immediately; no old layout motion blocks further input.
motion.reducedMotion: The paper geometry and all numerical measurements remain readable with optional transition effects removed.

evidence.expectedChange: The lines of cut-mark controls change state and subsequent photo proofs show cut edges.
